brand.name: YeHaike
brand.tagline: Unreal Engine plugins for data, networking, displays and local multiplayer
brand.description: Independent Unreal Engine plugin developer. Fourteen plugins covering SQLite, AES, TCP, UDP, HTTP, JSON, multi-window and multi-monitor output, split-screen, local multiplayer, runtime level transforms, procedural mesh, Blueprint graph export and rain shaders. All available on Fab.

products.name: SQLite Database for Unreal Engine 5
products.h1: SQLite Database for Unreal Engine — Blueprint CRUD, Save & Query
products.short: Read, write and query a real SQLite database from Blueprint. Persistent game data, no server.
products.answer: Unreal Engine has no built-in SQLite support. The native options are SaveGame objects and DataTables, and neither can run a query. This plugin exposes SQLite directly to Blueprint: open or create a .db file, run CREATE / INSERT / SELECT / UPDATE, and read the result set back as arrays — all local, with no server to deploy.
bullets: Full CRUD from Blueprint — no C++ and no SQL string escaping work
Query results come back as arrays you can loop over directly
Database file ships inside the project; nothing to install on the target machine
Ships on Win64, Android, iOS, macOS and Linux

products.name: AES Encryption for Unreal Engine
products.h1: AES Encryption for Unreal Engine — Encrypt Strings, Bytes & Files in Blueprint
products.short: Encrypt and decrypt strings, byte arrays and whole files with AES, from Blueprint.
products.answer: Encryption in Unreal lives in C++ only. FAES exists in the engine source, but no part of it is exposed to Blueprint — which is why protecting a save file normally means writing a C++ helper or wiring OpenSSL by hand. This plugin adds Blueprint nodes that encrypt and decrypt strings, byte arrays and whole files, on every target platform.
bullets: Encrypt and decrypt strings, byte arrays and entire files
Protects save data and config files without touching OpenSSL
UTF-8 safe, so non-Latin text survives the round trip
No runtime dependency on the target machine
products.buy_note: Pairs with the SQLite plugin if you need an encrypted database file.

products.name: TCP Socket Client & Server for Unreal Engine
products.h1: TCP Socket Client & Server for Unreal Engine — Blueprint Networking
products.short: Open TCP connections from Blueprint: connect, send, receive, or run a listener inside the game.
products.answer: Unreal's built-in networking is replication for multiplayer games. It is not a general-purpose socket layer, and Blueprint cannot open one. This plugin gives Blueprint raw TCP: connect as a client, run a listener as a server, and send or receive byte arrays — the shape you need for external tools, hardware and custom protocols.
bullets: Client and server in one plugin — listen inside the packaged game
Send and receive raw bytes, with callbacks on data arrival
Useful for hardware, robots, lab equipment and external tools
Runs on the game thread without blocking the frame
products.buy_note: For game replication, use the engine's built-in networking instead.

products.name: UDP Socket for Unreal Engine
products.h1: UDP Socket for Unreal Engine — Blueprint Send, Receive & Broadcast
products.short: Send and receive UDP packets from Blueprint, including broadcast and multicast.
products.answer: UDP is what sensors, phones and local tools usually speak, and Blueprint has no socket access at all. This plugin adds send, receive, broadcast and multicast nodes for UDP packets at runtime — the simplest way to talk to a device on the same network without writing a networking layer.
bullets: Send, receive, broadcast and multicast
Talks to sensors, phones, Arduino-class hardware and other apps
Low latency, no handshake, no connection state to manage
Pure Blueprint, no C++ required
products.buy_note: Choose TCP instead when delivery order matters.

products.name: HTTP & REST API Calls in Unreal Engine
products.h1: HTTP & REST API Calls in Unreal Engine — Blueprint GET / POST, JSON, Headers
products.short: Call any REST API from Blueprint: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, headers, JSON bodies, timeouts.
products.answer: Blueprint has no native HTTP node. The engine's FHttpModule is C++ only, which is why “how do I call a REST API from Blueprint” remains one of the most asked Unreal questions. This plugin exposes GET, POST, PUT and DELETE with custom headers, JSON bodies and timeouts, with async callbacks so the game thread never stalls waiting on the network.
bullets: GET, POST, PUT and DELETE with custom headers
JSON request bodies and parsed responses
Async callbacks — the frame never freezes on a slow endpoint
Timeouts and status-code access for real error handling
products.buy_note: The most-asked Unreal integration question; start here if you are new to Blueprint networking.

products.name: JSON Parse & Write for Unreal Engine
products.h1: JSON Parse & Write for Unreal Engine — Blueprint Nodes for Nested Objects
products.short: Parse and build JSON from Blueprint, including nested objects and arrays.
products.answer: FJsonObject is C++ only, so reading an API response or a config file from Blueprint normally means writing a C++ helper first. This plugin parses and builds JSON entirely in Blueprint, including nested objects and arrays, so data returned by an API can be turned into Blueprint structs without leaving the graph.
bullets: Parse responses with nested objects and arrays
Build JSON payloads for outgoing requests
Read config files without a C++ helper class
Natural companion to the HTTP plugin
products.buy_note: Lowest-priced plugin in the set — usually bought together with HTTP.

products.name: Multi-Window & Multi-Monitor for Unreal Engine
products.h1: Multi-Window & Multi-Monitor for Unreal Engine — Runtime Windows on Separate Displays
products.short: Spawn and control additional OS windows at runtime, each rendering its own camera on its own monitor.
products.answer: Unreal renders one viewport per window, and a second window means a second GameViewportClient — machinery the engine does not expose to Blueprint. This plugin opens additional OS windows at runtime, each bound to its own camera and output display, from the same build and the same game state. An instructor station, a debrief view or a control-room screen stops needing a second machine.
bullets: Independent runtime windows, one camera each, on the display you choose
Shares one game state — no sync layer between machines
Built for simulators, control rooms, exhibitions and arcade cabinets
Configured at runtime, so layouts can change per installation
products.buy_note: Each window is a full render pass, so cost scales with the number of cameras, not the number of screens. Budget GPU accordingly — three views is roughly 3× the render cost of one.

products.name: Split-Screen & Multi-View for Unreal Engine
products.h1: Split-Screen & Multi-View for Unreal Engine — Local Co-op, CCTV Walls, Replays
products.short: Render multiple cameras into one screen or separate viewports: split-screen, CCTV walls, replays.
products.answer: The engine's split-screen is fixed at two players with a layout chosen by the GameMode, and changing it means editing C++. This plugin renders any number of cameras into one screen or into separate viewports, configured at runtime — split-screen co-op, a CCTV wall, replay angles or a minimap, without touching engine code.
bullets: Any number of panes, not just two
Layouts configurable at runtime, per camera
Suits CCTV walls, replay angles and minimaps as well as co-op
No C++ and no GameMode surgery
products.buy_note: If you need each view on a separate physical monitor, use the multi-window plugin instead.

products.name: Local Multiplayer for Unreal Engine
products.h1: Local Multiplayer for Unreal Engine — Multiple Local Players & Split Input
products.short: Add a second, third or fourth local player at runtime with their own input device and camera.
products.answer: The engine supports local multiplayer, but adding a player mid-game with its own input device and camera requires GameMode configuration and C++. This plugin adds, removes and rebinds local players at runtime from Blueprint — the part that matters for couch co-op, arcade cabinets and party games where the number of players is not known until someone presses start.
bullets: Add or remove local players at runtime
Each player gets its own input device and camera
No GameMode edits and no C++
Built for couch co-op, arcade and party games
products.buy_note: Pairs with the multi-view plugin for more than two panes.

products.name: Runtime Level Transform for Unreal Engine
products.h1: Runtime Level Transform — Move, Rotate & Scale Whole Levels While Playing
products.short: Move, rotate and scale entire levels or level streams while the game is running.
products.answer: World Partition and level streaming are designed to load and unload, not to be moved. Transforming a whole level at runtime normally means reparenting every actor or building the world by hand. This plugin transforms whole levels and level streams — move, rotate, scale — while the game is running, which is what moving trains, elevators, rotating stations and procedural worlds actually need.
bullets: Transform entire levels and level streams at runtime
No per-actor reparenting
Built for moving vehicles, elevators and rotating structures
Works as the base for procedural world assembly
products.buy_note: Not a replacement for World Partition streaming — this is for moving, not loading.

products.name: Blueprint Graph Screenshot for Unreal Engine
products.h1: Blueprint Graph Screenshot — Export Blueprint Graphs as High-Resolution PNG
products.short: Export a whole Blueprint graph, or a selection, to a high-resolution PNG.
products.answer: The Unreal editor has no way to export a Blueprint graph as an image. Every tutorial, every asset documentation page and every store listing ends up as a screenshot of a zoomed-out graph that nobody can read. This free plugin renders the full graph — or just a selection — to a PNG at the resolution you choose, which is the whole reason it exists.
bullets: Exports the entire graph, not just the visible area
Selection-only export for close-ups
Resolution you choose — readable at print size
Free, and the easiest way to try the toolchain
products.buy_note: Free plugin. If it saves you time, the paid editor tooling is the natural next step.

products.name: Raindrops on Glass for Unreal Engine
products.h1: Raindrops on Glass — Lens & Window Rain Effect for Unreal Engine
products.short: Physically-based raindrops that stick, slide and merge on windows and camera lenses.
products.answer: Rain on glass is usually faked with a scrolling normal map, which reads as a screen effect rather than weather. This provides drops that stick, slide and merge on windows and camera lenses, tunable at runtime and compatible with Lumen and post-process, so the effect survives a camera move.
bullets: Drops stick, slide and merge rather than scrolling
Works on both windows and camera lenses
Compatible with Lumen and post-process
Parameters tweakable at runtime
products.buy_note: Best judged from the video on the listing — screenshots undersell it.

products.name: Gaussian Splatting for Unreal Engine
products.h1: Gaussian Splatting for Unreal Engine — Import & Render PLY Splats
products.short: Import PLY splat scans and render them in-engine as a placeable actor.
products.answer: Unreal Engine has no built-in Gaussian Splatting support. This plugin was an early attempt to close that gap: bring a .ply splat capture into the editor and render it in-engine instead of as a mesh. It is a legacy implementation, and the page below says so plainly — if you are starting a splat project today, read the comparison before you buy.
bullets: Imports .ply splat files as editor assets
Renders splats as a placeable actor you can move and frame
Useful for scans, exhibition content and previsualisation
Kept available for projects that already depend on it
products.notice: Legacy implementation — last updated 2023. It still imports and renders splats, but the ecosystem has moved on and several free, better-maintained options now exist. Read the comparison before buying; if a free option fits your scene size, use it.
products.buy_note: Ask before buying if your scene is large or you need shadows. A refund is worse for both of us than an honest answer up front.

products.name: Math Expression Procedural Mesh for Unreal Engine
products.h1: Math Expression Procedural Mesh — Build Meshes & Trajectories from Formulas
products.short: Turn a math formula into geometry: parametric surfaces, curves and trajectories at runtime.
products.answer: ProceduralMeshComponent gives you vertices and triangles. It does not give you a formula. This plugin evaluates a math expression into geometry — parametric surfaces, curves and projectile trajectories — with live parameter tweaking in the editor, so a shape can be tuned without recompiling or rebuilding a mesh by hand.
bullets: Evaluate a math expression into a procedural mesh
Parametric surfaces, curves and trajectories
Adjust parameters live in the editor
Useful for technical visualisation, projection surfaces and motion paths
products.notice: This listing has a single review, and it is negative. Read it before buying. If your project has a deadline, ask a question first — a refund costs us both more than a five-minute answer.
products.buy_note: Best suited to technical and visualisation work rather than general gameplay geometry.
